name: engineering-skills
description: Engineering skills for Next.js, React and Firebase projects, in three plugins (eng, fe, be), plus the official Firebase, Upstash and Cloudinary skills they build on.

plugins.name: eng
plugins.description: House engineering standards for Next.js, React, TypeScript and Firebase projects: structure, naming, TypeScript and schemas, monorepo, CI/CD, env, testing, scaffolding, shipping and reviewing changes, and the cross-cutting audits.

plugins.name: fe
plugins.description: House frontend standards for Next.js and React: React, Next.js, semantic HTML, accessibility, Tailwind, the design system, reusables, Storybook, SEO, frontend security, cookie consent and logos, with an audit per domain.

plugins.name: be
plugins.description: House backend standards for a Next.js API on Firebase: API architecture, the OpenAPI registry, backend security, Firebase, Redis, images, Cloudinary, field encryption, feature flags and maintenance mode, with an audit per domain.
